snippet.title: Kiln - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Get Fired Up for the Throwdown!

From Double Fine Productions (the studio that brought you Psychonauts, Brutal Legend, and Costume Quest), Kiln is an online multiplayer pottery party brawler that celebrates the deeply satisfying nature of creativity...and the joy of smashing those creations into smithereens!

Grab your friends and sculpt pottery that becomes the body you wear into battle, then face off in 4v4 matches where dousing the enemy team's kiln will carry you to victory. The size and shape of your pots determine your play-style and abilities. What shape will you make (and break)?

Available April 23 on Steam, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Xbox Cloud, Xbox Game Pass, and PlayStation 5.

Wishlist/Preorder Today:

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1165990/Kiln
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/kiln
PlayStation: https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/kiln/
